CONSULTANCY AGREEMENT 
 
 This Consultancy Agreement (“ Agreement ”) is entered into at [●] on this on this [●] day of [●] (“ Effective Date ”), by and between: 
 
 ZAMEEN DEVELOPMENTS (PRIVATE) Limited , a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan and having its office at 3 rd Floor, Pearl One, 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan (the “ Company ”) ; 
 
 AND 
 
 Mr./Ms. [●] daughter/son/wife of Mr. [●] resident of [●] having Computerized National Identity Card No. [●] (the “Consultant” ). 
 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 
 
 WHEREAS the Company is desirous of engaging, and the Consultant is willing to accept such engagement, for a fixed term to provide expert, professional, and skilled consultancy services related to the Consultant’s area of expertise and to perform the tasks and responsibilities in a timely, expeditious, and professional manner in accordance with the terms of this Agreement. 
 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE , the Parties agree as follows : 
 
 SCOPE OF CONSULTANCY SERVICES 
 
 Upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in this Agreement, t he Company hereby engages and the Consultant hereby agrees to the engagement as “ [●] ”, to provide and perform consultancy services , in a timely, expeditious, and professional manner, and in accordance with the terms of this Agreement. 
 
 This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall remain in effect for a period of [●] thereafter (“ Term ” ). 
 
 The services to be provided and performed by the Consultant, as further detailed in Annex ure A hereto (“ Consultancy Services ”), shall be in accordance with the following : 
 
 The Consultant shall perform the Consultancy Services from [●] or from such other locations as specified by the Company on an “as and when required basis” . 
 
 T he Consultant shall endeavour, at all times, to remain available for fulfilling the requirements of a n ‘ [●] . 
 
 Consultancy Services outline the domain of Consultant’s services in general; however, the Consultant shall perform and provide , from time to time, such other services as may be required by t he Company to meet the requirements of a n ‘ [●] . 
 
 
 RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN PARTIES 
 
 The Consultant is an independent c onsultant who is not an employee, agent, representative, assign or nominee of The Company and shall not at any time after termination or expiry of this Agreement , represent himself as connected with The Company in any capacity. 
 Consultant acknowledges and agrees that the Consultant does not have the authority to act for or on behalf of The Company or to enter into contracts that bind The Company in any respect whatsoever, or to incur any debts or liabilities or create obligations in the name of or on behalf of The Company , except in as far as authorised or required to perform his duties and obligations under this Agreement such as conducting, holding and representing The Company at meetings with relevant stakeholders . 
 
 During the Term or upon termination or expiry hereof, the Consultant shall not ipso facto be entitled to, demand or claim regular or permanent employment . 
 
 The Company shall provide to the Consultant such access to The Company ’s resources, data and information, personnel, equipment, and property as may be reasonably required by the Consultant to perform the Consultancy Services, subject to the Consultant’s confidentiality obligations hereunder. 
 
 
 REMUNERATION 
 
 In consideration of the Consultancy Services provided and performed by the Consultant, The Company shall pay to the Consultant, during the Term , such remuneration as has been specified in Annex ure B [Remuneration, Facilities, Terms of Reference and Payment Schedule] attached herewith (“ Remuneration ”). 
 
 Notwithstanding anything contained in this Agreement, tax liability, if any, shall be the exclusive liability of the Company . 
 
 Remuneration shall be paid on a monthly basis and shall be subject to such deductions (if any) as required by law or as mutually agreed between the P arties under the terms of this Agreement. All payments under this Agreement shall be via cheque/wire transfer in the designated bank account of the Consultant. 
 
 The Consultant is not entitled to receive or claim any benefit of any kind from t he Company , including any monetary or other compensation in addition to those specifically mentioned in Annex ure B . Further, the Consultant shall not be eligible to participate in any pension, health, vacation pay, sick pay, provident fund or other fringe benefit plan/policy that may be offered by t he Company to its permanent employees, or receive any salary, benefit, commission, bonus, rate or allowance other than those specifically mentioned in Annex ure B during Term . 
 
 
 WARRANTIES AND REPRESENTATIONS 
 
 Consultant represents and warrants to t he Company that he is under no contractual or other restrictions or obligations which are inconsistent with the execution of this Agreement or which will interfere with the performance of his obligations under this Agreement . 
 
 Consultant represents and warrants that all Consultancy Services provided and performed under this Agreement shall be provided and performed in a prompt and diligent manner while exercising professional skill and reasonable care , and at a level of proficiency and expertise that is reasonably expected of an expert consultant having the expertise and experience that the Consultant has represented he has. 
 
 Consultant hereby gives consent to t he Company to monitor and record exchange of any communication, information, or data conducted by the Consultant via t he Company 's electronic systems. The Consultant understands and acknowledges that the aforesaid consent is necessary for the purpose of ensuring compliance with t he Company ’s policies, as may be amended from time to time, prevent misuse of t he Company ’s facilities, breach of confidentiality or any other term of this Agreement. 
 
 
 CODE OF CONDUCT 
 
 The Consultant shall, at all times, both within and outside of working hours, conduct himself in a proper and fitting manner towards t he Company and its customers and duly and properly observe, obey, comply with and adhere to, in all respects, all policies of t he Company (as may be amended from time to time), applicable local laws, rules and regulations. 
 
 The Consultant shall not assign the benefit of this Agreement to any third party and shall not delegate to a third party the duties and obligations required to be performed by him under the Agreement. The Consultant shall not act in any manner contrary to the interests of t he Company . 
 
 
 INVENTIONS &amp; INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS 
 
 " Work Product " shall mean all work conceived, developed or created by the Consultant, solely or jointly with t he Company or its p ersonnel, during the Term . Consultant hereby assigns to t he Company all right s , title, and interest in and related to the Work Product, which shall be the sole and exclusive property of t he Company , and the Consultant shall not have any rights of any kind whatsoever upon such Work Product. 
 
 
 CONFIDENTIALITY 
 
 Confidential Information shall mean any information supplied , furnished or disclosed to the Consultant relating to this Agreement , the business and affairs of t he Company and its associated companies, and/or in relation to the Consultant’s duties/responsibilities as the ‘ [●]’ , either in writing or orally, through electronic or paper documentation, during the Term (“Confidential Information”) . 
 
 The Consultant shall keep the Confidential Information confidential and take all reasonable precautions to protect the Confidential Information. The Consultant shall not disclose Confidential Information or any part thereof to any third party whether during the Term or after termination hereof for any reason whatsoever other than as directed by t he Company in writing . 
 
 
 NON-COMPETE &amp; NON-SOLICITATION 
 
 During the Term , Consultant will not engage in any service or activity that is substantially similar to or in direct competition with the business activities of t he Company without obtaining prior written consent of t he Company . 
 
 The Consultant agrees that the Consultant shall not (a) solicit, entice away, discourage or influence in any way an existing or prospective supplier, vendor, contractor, customer or client of t he Company (b) recruit, solicit, induce or attempt to induce for employment, any c onsultant of The Company or its affiliates. 
 
 
 
 CONFLICT OF INTEREST 
 
 At the time of signing of this Agreement, the Consultant declares and confirms that he has no obligations to any employer or other person or organization that may interfere with his obligations under this Agreement , result in any conflict of interest for The Company , its affiliates or clients. Moreover, the Consultant undertakes that a ny engagement, direct or indirect, by the Consultant, during the Term that may interfere with his obligations under this Agreement, result in any conflict of interest for The Company , its affiliates or clients, shall be with the mutual understanding of the Parties . 
 
 The Consultant agrees to disclose any matter urgently to t he Company including personal/professional matters if it involves conflict of interest between his personal commitments and his obligations under this Agreement. 
 
 The Consultant shall not, directly or indirectly, accept any commission, rebate, discount, or gratuity, in cash or in kind, from any person, partnership or any third party who has or is likely to have any sort of relationship with t he Company , its subsidiaries or associated entities. 
 
 
 TERMINATION 
 
 This Agreement may be terminated by either Party upon se rving of at least one (1) month ’ s written notice to the other Party, or in lieu thereof, paying to the other an amount equal to one (1) month’s remuneration, at any time during the Term; or 
 
 The Company is entitled to terminate this Agreement at any time without notice if the Consultant: 
 
 commits a serious breach of this Agreement or any representation or warranty herein; 
 
 violates any law, rule or regulation; 
 
 is incapacitated or unable to perform his duties in t he Company ; 
 
 in the reasonable opinion of t he Company , the Consultant is found negligent and incompetent in performance of his duties or is guilty of any fraud or dishonest acts which are adverse to the interests of t he Company . 
 
 The rights of t he Company to terminate this Agreement are without prejudice to any other rights that it may have under the law. 
 
 On termination of this Agreement, the Consultant shall immediately (a) deliver to t he Company all the documents, records, books, all documents pertaining to Confidential Information, information relating to business affairs, mobile phones, computer, and any keys, which are in the possession of the Consultant or under his control; and (b) delete all Confidential Information from any computer disks, tapes or other re-usable material in his possession or under his control and destroy all other documents and tangible items and properties in his possession or under his control, which contain or refer to any Confidential Information. 
 
 If upon or after the termination of this Agreement for any reason whatsoever, the Consultant is or becomes indebted to t he Company in any sum or sums of money, The Company shall have the right to retain and set off against the amount of such indebtedness the whole or any part of the money then or thereafter becoming due to the Consultant. The forgoing right shall be in addition and without prejudice to all other rights, powers and remedies of t he Company to recover or obtain payment of the amount of such indebtedness. 
 
 The Consultant’s obligations of confidentiality, non-compete and non-solicitation, and indebtedness under this Agreement shall survive expiry or termination hereof. 
 
 
 MISCELLANEOUS 
 
 Any notice herein referred to shall be in writing and shall be sufficiently given to or served on the Party to whom it is addressed via registered post or email. Notices should be addressed to the Parties at the addresses first written above, or to such other address as a Party shall specify in writing. Notices shall be deemed delivered within 3 ( three ) working days if sent by registered post, or within 24 (twenty-four) hours if sent by email, 
 
 This Agreement (including the schedules and annexure attached hereto or delivered in connection herewith) constitutes the entire Agreement between the Parties and overrides any and all verbal or written arrangements made by and between the Parties prior to the execution of this Agreement. 
 
 Each Party shall in good faith perform their obligations under this Agreement based on confidence placed by such Party in the other and thereon relied upon by such Party. 
 
 This Agreement shall be construed in accordance with and governed by the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. 
 
 Any dispute under or arising out of this Agreement shall be referred in accordance with the Arbitration Act, 1940 and the decision of the arbitrator shall be final and binding on the Parties. 
 
 Consultant shall indemnify and hold harmless t he Company from and against all claims, damages, losses, and expenses arising out of or resulting from any decision made by the Consultant without prior approval of t he Company ’s higher management . 
 
 If either Party fails to fulfill its/his obligations hereunder when such failure is due to an event of force majeure, then such failure shall not be considered a default of obligations hereunder for the duration of such event, and for such time thereafter as is reasonable to enable the affected Party or Parties to resume performance under this Agreement. Provided that in no event shall such time extend for a period of more than ten (10) business days. 
 
 This Agreement may not be amended except by an instrument in writing signed on behalf of each of the Parties hereto. 
 
 The provisions of this Agreement are severable. 
 
 
 Any of the terms or conditions of this Agreement may be waived at any time by the Party or Parties hereto entitled to the benefit thereof. Waiver shall be in writing signed by or on behalf of the Party or Parties waiving such terms or conditions.
